verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP against control requirements. A Monitors page shows each monitor's status (healthy, violations found, connection errors), and the product alerts on compliance violations, with the dashboard flagging controls that need attention. Refresh cadence is documented only as 'up to daily or ad-hoc', so surfacing failures within hours is not clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented sub-daily test frequency or alert latency, detail on alert delivery channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
